title: Novel syntrophic isovalerate-oxidizing bacteria and methanogens in methanogenic chemostats
description: Using metagenomic and metatranscriptomic analyses, the draft genomes of these dominant populations were reconstructed and represented phylogenetically novel clades. These novel populations possess genetic abilities of isovalerate oxidation , H2/formate production, and unique intercellular electron transfer
